mapper.select: SELECT t1.task_name, t1.task_id, t3.test_answer_id, t3.`status`, t3.test_name FROM ms_task AS t1 LEFT JOIN ms_task_test_answer AS t2 ON t1.task_id = t2.task_id AND t2.del_flag = 0 JOIN ms_test_answer AS t3 ON t2.test_answer_id = t3.test_answer_id AND t3.del_flag = 0 AND t3.user_id = #{userId} WHERE t1.grade = #{grade} AND t1.del_flag = 0

select ta.task_name, ta.grade, te.test_id, te.test_name, s.subject_name, te.create_time from ms_task ta left join ms_task_test tt on ta.task_id=tt.task_id and tt.del_flag='0' left join ms_test te on tt.test_id=te.test_id and te.del_flag='0' left join ms_subjects s on te.subject_id=s.subject_id and s.del_flag='0' where ta.task_id=#{taskId} and ta.del_flag='0'
